Main ke Kudus closed Period 1 with an estimated 2.254 followers, up 2.157 during July to October 2026. Account insights recorded 729.954 views and 11.166 profile visits over the four months.

Publishing output reached 351 posts against a period quota of 240. Stories accounted for 232 posts, while Feed, Reels and video content totalled 119. Monthly Feed, Reels and video output fell from 45 to 18.

The next steps are to maintain useful editorial content, strengthen publishing consistency and improve the path from Instagram to the website. The 3.000-follower goal for 31 December 2026 requires 746 more net followers from the closing balance.

Monthly account insights from the Instagram Graph API cover July to October 2026. Output comes from the Publishing Log and website sessions from GA4.
Follower totals use recorded or reconstructed balances. Estimated figures are marked on the audience slide.
Reach counts unique accounts each month. Monthly reach cannot be added together. Months with 31 days cover the first 30.
Post metrics use the 4 November 2026 snapshot, not 31 October 2026. They may include activity after the reporting period. Account totals retain the four calendar months. Other snapshot dates are not substituted. Missing metrics are shown as n/a.
Per-post follows may be supplemented with lifetime CSV counts, including activity after the period. CSV uploaded 5 November 2026, export date unknown. The Instagram API does not provide Reel follows or profile visits.
